items.description: Disposal of shed roof timber and broken glass pane
items.rationale: Both the shed roof timber and broken glass are 'material arising' from insured property damaged by storm (5.2.1(a)), and both are covered under the policy for the declared garden building. Reference Cases 8 and 10 show t for similar lines between 30–75 (glass) and below 75 (timber), but Case 10 for a combined line (timber, glass, green waste, root ball <1m³) gives t between 157–218 for 4 pcs. Here, only timber and glass (2 pcs) are included, so t should be below the combined reference, likely around 60–70 per item.

items.description: Combined storm-clearance load: felled-tree green waste, root mass >1m³, excavated soil
items.rationale: This is a combined position (1.3, 7.1.10) mixing indemnifiable (felled-tree green waste, 5.2.1(b)) and excluded (root mass >1m³ and excavated soil, both excluded by 5.2.1(e) and 5.2.1(d)). Per 7.1.10, if any element is not indemnifiable, the whole line is not indemnified. Reference Cases 8 and 10 confirm that ground material and root masses over 1m³ are excluded, and combined lines are not split.

Disposal of ground material (paving grit) is excluded under 5.2.1(d) unless part of a reinstatement operation per 5.2.2, which is not the case here (no repair of paved surface). Reference Cases 8 and 10 confirm t = 0 for similar lines.

items.description: Disposal of sieved topsoil from churned-up ground
items.rationale: Disposal of ground material (topsoil) is excluded under 5.2.1(d) unless part of a reinstatement operation per 5.2.2, which is not the case here (no repair of ground or surface). Reference Cases 8 and 10 confirm t = 0 for similar lines.
